sources.name: Victoria Vicmap Parcel (PARCEL_MP)
sources.scope: Victoria cadastral parcel map polygons; distinct from local-government property assessment units. Other Australian states use separate datasets. Only Approved (A) parcel and version records are ground; Proposed (P) records are excluded. Crown and government-road parcels remain included. Only G (unrestricted ground) and S (ground surface affected by strata) levels are ground; above/below strata are excluded. Additional enabled city entries have separate bounded qualification evidence; wider coverage remains unverified.

Citywide completeness, legal title, survey accuracy, and currentness are not established.
